key_points: Halliburton secured a multi‑year well construction and completions contract with Eni for the ultra‑deepwater Cronos project in Cyprus
The deal leverages existing Cyprus infrastructure, adding to Halliburton's offshore service footprint
Analysts cite the contract as a catalyst that may justify a higher valuation and suggest the stock is undervalued
Revenue impact will accrue over the coming quarters as the project ramps up, not an immediate earnings surprise
No contradictory news; other headlines are generic or unrelated, keeping the net view positive
